channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Ryan hails Ballygunner hunger after second All-Ireland win
item.description: Jason Ryan attributed Ballygunner's second All-Ireland club SHC triumph in three years to the hunger of the players.

item.title: Match-winner Geaney basks in career highlight
item.description: Mikey Geaney has described winning the All-Ireland club SFC title with Dingle as 'the most special day in my career'.

item.title: Sutcliffe retires from Dublin duty
item.description: Former All-Star Danny Sutcliffe has retired from inter-county hurling.

item.title: Dineen takes charge of Westmeath club
item.description: Former Roscommon sharpshooter Nigel Dineen has been named as the new senior football manager of Westmeath club Caulry.

item.title: 'His striking ability, his saves today were key'
item.description: Stephen O'Keeffe came in for special praise from Ballygunner manager Jason Ryan after his man of the match performance in last Sunday's All-Ireland club SHC final.

item.title: O'Rourke claims three counties have 'no interest' in winning League
item.description: With the 2026 Allianz Football League starting this weekend, Colm O'Rourke reckons three counties will have no desire to win the competition.

item.title: O'Sullivan returns to Dr Crokes hotseat
item.description: Kerry giants Dr Crokes have appointed Edmund O'Sullivan as their new senior football manager.

item.title: Galway footballers won't grace Tuam Stadium again this year
item.description: Many Galway football fans are lamenting the prospect of not seeing the county's senior footballers in action at Tuam Stadium again this year.

item.title: Dublin players to protest over Allianz League sponsorship
item.description: Dublin's senior footballers and hurlers are planning to protest over Allianz's continued sponsorship of the National Leagues this weekend.

item.title: Demolition of Casement Park to start next week
item.description: Ulster GAA have confirmed that the old stand in Casement Park will be demolished with work commencing the last week in January.
